description: This Kotlin source file defines the 'HomeSectionsAdapter' class used in an Android app. It handles rendering different sections of a home screen UI, including headers, banners, and content rows, within a RecyclerView. The file includes multiple ViewHolder classes for each section type, customization of layouts and focus behavior, and uses DiffUtil for efficient list updates.

classes.name: HomeSectionsAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for rendering home screen sections including header, banner, and content rows within a RecyclerView.

classes.name: HeaderSectionVH
classes.description: ViewHolder for the header section containing brand title and top navigation bar.

classes.name: BannerSectionVH
classes.description: ViewHolder for the banner section, a horizontally scrolling pager with banners.

classes.name: ContentRowSectionVH
classes.description: ViewHolder for individual content rows, each containing a horizontal list of cards.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds data to the header section, setting up styling and focus behaviors.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds data to banner section, configuring layout, size adjustments, and focus behaviors.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds a content row with its title and items, managing focus and rectangle scrolling.
